surprises: SF-1: Contracts say ranged reads use TXN#<from> to TXN#<to>, but a BETWEEN with hi = TXN#<to> would drop every row of the last month (TXN#<to>-dd#id sorts after TXN#<to>). ADR 0004 documents the upper bound as TXN#<to>~ (tilde sorts after every date and id character). PR 3 handlers should build it that way.

SF-3: npm 11.19 warns that esbuild@0.28.2 has a postinstall script not covered by allowScripts. It was not approved (no config change); esbuild still runs (npx esbuild --version = 0.28.2) through its platform optional dependency.

SF-6: the API stack reads all four SSM values, and none is referenced yet (the authorizer is unbound, and table and bucket names wait for PR 2), so synth prints CloudFormation-Validate W2001 warnings for all four in every stage. CloudFormation still resolves them at deploy time, which is why the SF-11 blocker applies to all four.
SF-6: Stack.addDependency is deprecated in aws-cdk-lib 2.274; stage.ts uses addStackDependency.

SF-8: the store interface gains one shape the brief did not list: query({ pk }) with neither prefix nor between reads the whole partition, because DynamoDB refuses an empty begins_with prefix and delete-all (PR 3) must read every item. The memory store also returns a cursor on a full last page, as DynamoDB does, so callers must accept an empty final page.

SF-8 (for PR 3): ERASED.quiet_until is an ISO string and the rollup t is ms epoch; a condition comparing them is false in both stores (type mismatch, as in DynamoDB). The rollup must compare quiet_until with new Date(t).toISOString().

SF-9 (for PR 3): aws-cdk-lib stream read grants (grantStreamRead, DynamoEventSource) add dynamodb:ListStreams on "*", which T-INF-8 refuses. The rollup wiring will need stream-ARN-scoped statements (or an EventSourceMapping without the CDK grant), or a recorded D-21 deviation if ListStreams on * is truly required.

SF-9: an unbound HttpJwtAuthorizer synthesizes no resource, so T-INF-7 binds it to a probe route inside the test to check issuer and audience. ApiStack also exposes httpApi and stage publicly; makeFunction reads the stage from the stack so its signature stays as the brief.

SF-9: the bundled SDK keeps two guarded requires of optional packages (@aws-sdk/signature-v4-crt, @aws-sdk/signature-v4a) that are not installed; the SDK loads them only for SigV4a, which nothing here uses.

SF-11: CI runs Node 22 (setup-node node-version 22) but this machine has only Node 24.21 and 26.10, so the ts-node harness and esbuild bundling were verified on Node 24 only. deploy.yml runs on pushes to main, staging and qa (and by hand), not on pull requests, so the first Node 22 run is the push to qa after merge; a failing npm test there stops before credentials and any deploy.
SF-8: two commits (1edd5bc and the follow-up 97d679c for a review minor), both tied to SF-8; kept rather than rewriting SF-9 and SF-10 history.

SF-12: the SF-6 W2001 warnings are gone (no SSM template parameters remain). The custom resource adds one CDK singleton function (logical id AWS679f53fac002430cb0da5b7982bd2287) that T-INF-7 and T-INF-8 recognise by that id. Each deploy re-reads the four values, because the physical id changes every synth; a missing parameter fails the api stack deploy.

SF-12 (conformance F3): readStageValues assumes SSM GetParameters answers in name order. It was checked read-only with two names, and AWS does not document it. T-INF-13 cannot catch a different live order. A swap of user-pool-id and client-id would make the authorizer refuse every token (fails closed). Check after the first qa deploy: aws ssm get-parameters with the four names lists bucket-name, table-name, user-pool-client-id, user-pool-id in that order. Mapping by name inside the resource would need one GetParameter resource per name, against D-33's single resource, so it was not done.

Conformance F4: choices the brief does not name, no decision touched: preventUserExistenceErrors on the app client; API CORS methods GET/POST/PUT/DELETE, headers authorization and content-type, maxAge 1 hour; esbuild minify plus a createRequire banner for ESM bundles.
